title: Leuco-Ethiopic
summary: LEUCO-ETHIOP'IC, adjective [Gr. white, and black.] White and black; designating a white animal of a black species, or the albino.

inlines.v: LEUCO-ETHIOP'IC, adjective [Gr. white, and black.] White and black; designating a white animal of a black species, or the albino.
